story.fullStory:
Elvis Costello's "Veronica" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Veronica" is a song by Elvis Costello, released in 1989 as the lead single from his album Spike.

The song was co-written by Costello with Paul McCartney, was co-produced with T-Bone Burnett and Kevin Killen, and features McCartney on his iconic Höfner bass.

In 2004, Entertainment Weekly voted it one of Costello's "10 Greatest Tunes".

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.
